s.note: Oven-baked caramel popcorn with salted peanuts, crisp and glassy
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a big covered pot, shaking constantly, then tip into a large roasting tin with 100g salted peanuts. Heat the oven to 120C. Melt 100g butter with 150g brown sugar, 60ml golden syrup and 0.5 tsp salt and boil for 4 minutes without stirring. Take off the heat, stir in 0.5 tsp bicarb soda, pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then spread on baking paper to cool and break into clusters.

s.note: Hot spinach and artichoke dip with parmesan and mozzarella, baked bubbling, with pita chips
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt and bake for 10 minutes until crisp. Squeeze 250g thawed frozen spinach dry and chop a 280g jar of drained marinated artichoke hearts. Mix 250g soft cream cheese with 125g sour cream, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 50g grated parmesan, half of 100g grated mozzarella, the spinach, artichokes and black pepper. Spread in a small baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 5 minutes and serve with the pita chips.

m.note: Ohio-style spiced beef chilli over spaghetti, with kidney beans, onion and a mound of cheddar
m.how: Put 750g beef mince in a large pot with 1 litre cold water and break it up with a whisk until fine. Add 2 diced onions, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 140g tomato paste, 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp each of ground cinnamon and cumin, 1 tsp allspice, 0.25 tsp ground cloves, 1 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 2 bay leaves and 1.5 tsp salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer uncovered for 1.5 hours, stirring now and then, until thick but still saucy, and skim off the fat. Cook 400g spaghetti and divide between 4 plates. Ladle over the chilli and top with a warmed 400g tin of kidney beans, 1 finely diced raw onion and 200g very finely grated cheddar. Serve with small salted crackers.

w.note: Peanut butter balls half dipped in dark chocolate, kept cold
w.how: Beat 250g smooth peanut butter with 60g soft butter, 1 tsp vanilla extract and a pinch of salt, then work in 250g icing sugar. Roll into 2.5cm balls on a lined tray and freeze for 30 minutes. Melt 250g dark chocolate with 1 tsp coconut oil. Spear each ball with a toothpick and dip in the chocolate, leaving a circle of peanut butter showing on top, and smooth over the hole with a finger. Chill for 30 minutes until set. Makes about 28.

d.note: Bourbon shaken with muddled cherries, mint and lemon over crushed ice
d.how: Stir 60g caster sugar into 60ml hot water until dissolved and cool. Muddle 200g pitted cherries with a handful of mint leaves and the syrup in a shaker. Add 240ml bourbon, 80ml lemon juice and a scoop of ice and shake hard, in two batches. Strain over crushed ice in 4 tumblers and top each with a cherry and a mint sprig.
